Featured image for the iPhone and iPad guide: a smartphone with a blank white screen on a light wooden table, no logos or apps on screen. Photo by Vojtech Bruzek (unsplash.com/photos/J82GxqnwKSs), Unsplash License.

Featured image for the macOS IPTV guide, showing a MacBook to represent compatibility with Apple computers.

Featured image for the Samsung TV guide: a wall-mounted TV, switched off, in a bright modern living room, with no logos or content on screen. Photo by Caroline Badran (unsplash.com/photos/prIf3TI-U54), Unsplash License.

Featured image for the Apple TV guide: a TV, switched off, on a white cabinet in a minimalist room, with no logos or content on screen. Photo by Margo Evardson (unsplash.com/photos/HWAyAtxbDVk), Unsplash License.
